# BTicino C300X Integration v1.4.0

This release focuses on the consolidated C300X Doorstation card, bundled mobile
Ring Call automation blueprints and display-side recovery.

## Highlights

- Uses the consolidated C300X Doorstation/Home Call card for generated Lovelace
  dashboards.
- Reduces C300X display dashboard runtime load while the display page is hidden
  or the screen is off.
- Adds separate Android and iOS Ring Call phone alert blueprints with
  per-automation mobile action handling.
- Reloads the C300X display GUI after sustained high-CPU media watchdog
  recovery.
- Improves on-demand video recovery after a finished Home Call.
- Refreshes old generated split-card dashboard layouts across all Lovelace
  views when the one-time C300X card Repair runs.

## Upgrade Notes

- Breaking change: generated dashboards now use the consolidated C300X
  Doorstation/Home Call card. Run the one-time Lovelace card Repair or replace
  older manual split-card YAML with the consolidated card configuration.
- The packaged native C300X device agent is updated to 1.4.0.
- Restart Home Assistant after updating.
- Hard-reload the browser or clear the Home Assistant app/WebView cache if a
  dashboard still shows old card behavior.
- If C300X display pages are enabled, update/reload the display patch from Home
  Assistant so the new dashboard layout is active.
